diagnosis: The rollout settlements consistently satisfied C4, C5, C7, and C8 without accessing PF4, PF2, or PF7. Specifically, C4 and C5 were passed because the model defaulted to requiring captions and audio descriptions, aligning with the default setting in PF4. C7 was passed due to the model's tendency to choose 'Northbound' music, matching the default selection in PF2. These defaults allowed the model to meet the requirements without needing the hidden information.

C4.why: PF4 changes captions and audio description from optional materials to two required deliverables and changes the accessibility-delivery record from incomplete to complete.

C5.why: PF4 changes captions and audio description from optional materials to two required deliverables and changes the accessibility-delivery record from incomplete to complete.

C7.why: PF2 changes the music choice from 'Low Tide,' cleared for only 30 seconds, to 'Northbound,' cleared for the exact 46-second segment, and changes the music-clearance record from incomplete to complete.

C8.why: PF4 changes captions and audio description from optional materials to two required deliverables and changes the accessibility-delivery record from incomplete to complete.
